page_title: OpenAGI: When LLM Meets Domain Experts

summary.name: OpenAGI
summary.one_liner: OpenAGI is an open-source research and development platform where an LLM receives natural language tasks, selects and runs domain expert models, tools, or APIs to solve multi-step problems.
use_cases: Benchmarking LLM agents on standard multi-step tasks
Combining an LLM with specialized expert models
Studying reinforcement learning from task feedback
summary.what_it_does: The page is an arXiv paper abstract introducing OpenAGI, an open-source AGI research and development platform for solving multi-step, real-world tasks. Tasks are given to an LLM as natural language queries, and the LLM selects and executes appropriate expert models, tools, plugins, or APIs. The platform combines standard benchmark tasks for evaluation with open-ended tasks for creative problem-solving. The authors also propose Reinforcement Learning from Task Feedback (RLTF), which uses task results to improve the LLM's task-solving ability. The project code, dataset, benchmarks, evaluation methods, and UI demo are stated to be open-sourced on GitHub.
notable: Dual strategy of standard benchmark tasks plus open-ended expandable tasks
Reinforcement Learning from Task Feedback (RLTF) for a self-improving feedback loop
LLM selects and executes domain expert models, tools, and APIs from natural language queries
Code, dataset, benchmarks, evaluation methods, and UI demo released open-source
caveats: The page is a research paper abstract; it does not describe installation or usage steps
AGI is described by the authors as an open research challenge with no defined solution path
